Remote work platform · Case study

SyncSpace

One workspace for conversations, tasks, time tracking, and planning, designed to reduce everyday tool switching.

Remote work · Product design

Read overview
OverviewDesign process & screensMore projects

The challenge

Remote employees switch between Google Chat, DeskTime, Jira, Google Calendar, and Confluence. Daily plans become fragmented, while team culture and wellbeing are harder to maintain.

The users

The study considers remote employees who need to work with fewer interruptions, alongside project managers and HR teams who need visibility into progress and time.

The direction

A unified workspace brings tasks, time tracking, meetings, and updates together, while making room for team connection and a more focused workday.
